svg.text: Zabbix, NetBox and netops-ai only need to reach the management network. netops-ai logs in to the devices read-only (SSH), reads Zabbix and NetBox, and calls the LLM.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: Zabbix、NetBox 和 netops-ai 只要能访问管理网就行。netops-ai 以只读账号 SSH 登录设备，读 Zabbix 和 NetBox，并调用大模型。
